basic_info.description: Exquisitely designed, this top-floor, 2-level condominium in a coveted two-unit building offers unparalleled luxury in the heart of the Marina District. Just 1.5 blocks from Chestnut Street, this residence features a private 500 sq. ft. roof deck with a built-in outdoor kitchen and breathtaking panoramic views of the Golden Gate Bridge and Pacific Heights. A perfect setting to enjoy the Blue Angels. Inside, the three-bedroom, 2.5-bath home boasts two serene primary suites at the rear for privacy, one with a separate sitting room and custom walk-in closet. The third bedroom doubles as an office with elegant pocket doors. The chef's kitchen is outfitted with top-tier appliances, including a Sub-Zero refrigerator, Wolf range, Fisher & Paykel dishwasher drawers, and a 48-bottle Sub-Zero wine fridge.  Additional features include a gas fireplace, 5-zone Sonos sound system, AV with surround sound in living room, radiant heated bathroom floors, and a Nest thermostat. A private garage offers EV charging and space for 1-2 cars. Steps from Marina Green, Crissy Field, and the Presidio, this home blends refined design, modern amenities, and an unbeatable location. Down-to-the-studs remodel and full seismic upgrade in 2014-15.
